blurb: Sea Star Fishing Charters offers private group charters for sport fishing, whale watching, marine science labs, and burials at sea. They fish local kelp beds, rocky reefs, and offshore banks from Dana Point to La Jolla. The prime fishing season is April through November with various fish species available.

quotes.author: Eddie Cabral
quotes.text: Captain Joe is living on purpose! I was blessed to be a guest of Julie Klassen and family for a burial at sea of her brother. Captain Joe’s insight and wisdom as well as intellectual brilliance is a joy to behold. As a lifelong spiritualist weened on the fishing villages of Cape Cod, I was particularly impressed by his navigation skills into the souls of men and the great big beautiful sea. What a beautiful sweet release it was. Thank you, Captain Joe for your divinely directed purpose driven life.

quotes.author: Rosemary Hernandez
quotes.text: Captain Joe provided an excellent experience for our family. There was plenty of gear available. He has years of experience and it shows. He has very good patience with the young novice fishermen. We caught plenty of different types of fish. They were all cleaned very nice by the deckhand Paul. We took home a large bag of cleaned fish. We also got a bonus in that we were in the middle of a large school of dolphins that swam with the boat for a good distance. I highly recommend this charter.

quotes.author: Tara Dailey
quotes.text: Capt Joe and Jacob were absolutely amazing. Extremely considerate and patient with our questions and made our Naval Honor Funeral Service peaceful and lovely. Our Dad was honored and would have loved the service... And I'm sure he did from watching us from above. Highly recommend.

quotes.author: Tara Connor
quotes.text: We did a burial at sea with captain joe I couldn’t speak more highly about his professionalism and hosting capabilities he made our family feel comfortable during a tough time. I will always remember the experience and have so much respect for what he does. He’s a class act!

quotes.author: Jamie Flechsig
quotes.text: Our family went out on a half day fishing adventure and we all had the most amazing time! Captain Joe is very knowledgeable, fun and such an excellent teacher. My 11 year old daughter was over the moon excited to catch so many fish. We will never forget this fun experience.
